INSERT INTO event_log (actor_type, actor_id, channel, event_type, raw_text, parsed_json)
VALUES ('system', '{{ String($json.sender_ref || "email").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'email', 'email_auto_ignored',
  '{{ String($json.subject || "automated email").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  jsonb_build_object('provider_message_id', '{{ String($json.provider_message_id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
RETURNING true AS ignored;

SELECT 'AIRTABLE_BASE_ID_PLACEHOLDER'::text base_id,m.airtable_record_id,'Attachments'::text field_name FROM communication_message c JOIN airtable_record_map m ON m.entity_type='communication' AND m.entity_id=c.id WHERE c.channel='email' AND c.provider_message_id='{{ String($('Normalize Vendor Email').first().json.provider_message_id || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}'
UNION ALL SELECT 'AIRTABLE_BASE_ID_PLACEHOLDER',sm.airtable_record_id,'Evidence' FROM communication_message c JOIN airtable_record_map sm ON sm.entity_type='stage' AND sm.entity_id=c.stage_id WHERE c.channel='email' AND c.provider_message_id='{{ String($('Normalize Vendor Email').first().json.provider_message_id || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}';

parameters.jsCode: const uploads=$('Normalize Vendor Email').first().json.attachment_uploads||[];const out=[];for(const item of $input.all()){if(!item.json.airtable_record_id||String(item.json.base_id||'').includes('PLACEHOLDER'))continue;for(const upload of uploads)out.push({json:{...item.json,upload_body:upload,upload_url:'https://content.airtable.com/v0/'+item.json.base_id+'/'+item.json.airtable_record_id+'/'+encodeURIComponent(item.json.field_name)+'/uploadAttachment'}});}return out;
